label: Full-width five-layer Gemma-2 architecture transfer; not a trained DSpark reproduction

transfer_choices.geometry: Gemma-2 9B target width, FFN, GQA and RoPE; Qwen3 DSpark attention/norm/SwiGLU mechanism
transfer_choices.mask: Frozen Gemma pad-token embedding, repeated; not an upstream Gemma-2 mask-token claim
transfer_choices.input: Frozen Gemma embedding multiplied by sqrt(3584)
transfer_choices.output: Learned final draft RMSNorm, frozen F16 tied projection, independent vocabulary correction, then Gemma softcap
transfer_choices.taps: Five zero-based block-output taps; teacher final-normalized features are separate and never input at a future position

status: model-equations-only; full-teacher training data, run contract, native packing/execution and chat integration remain required
